headline: Reliance New Energy discloses substantial acquisition of Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy
sum: Reliance New Energy Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI takeover norms, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited, indicating a strategic consolidation in the renewables sector.
detail: Reliance New Energy Limited, the renewable energy arm of Reliance Industries, has submitted a disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares in Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure was filed with the National Stock Exchange on or about 22 June 2026. The filing indicates a material shareholding event requiring immediate disclosure and suggests potential consolidation of renewable energy capacity within the Reliance group. Specifics of the acquisition value, timeline, and shareholding percentage are contained in the filed disclosure document.
